0:
set -eu
git config --global --add safe.directory /config
if [ -f /config/configuration.yaml ]; then
  echo "/config already initialized, skipping clone"
  exit 0
fi
if [ -n "$(find /config -mindepth 1 -not -name 'lost+found' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: /config is not empty but has no configuration.yaml; refusing to clone" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git config --global http.extraHeader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GIT_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
git clone --branch "$GIT_BRANCH" "$GIT_REPO_URL" /config
echo "Cloned $GIT_REPO_URL ($GIT_BRANCH) into /config"

set -e
git config --global --add safe.directory /config
git config --global http.extraHeader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GIT_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
exec sh /config/utils/commit-all.sh

      "ping_unit3d": True,

      "use_sonarr": True,
